name: Albescent-Hoodoo
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by towering mountain ranges. Farther poleward, past tectonic rift valleys, the silence feels older than the soil.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
